project.title: 16S rDNA sequencing from methane-acclimated sludge and methane microbial fuel cells
project.description: This 16S rDNA sequencing was carried out in an attempt to identify members of an previously un-characterized consortia used in syntrophy with defined members to generate electrical current in methane-based microbial fuel cells. Analyses from these reads provided insight into dynamics between consortium members in the methane-based microbial fuel cells.
